steps.name: ruman
steps.objective: Go to “Luman” and complete the quest from [Priest Miya].

steps.name: Invasion of Lux 2nd Legion
steps.objective: Defeat [Wild Owlbear] and [Karka Assassin] in “Whitecall Canyon”.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Welcome to Luman, Adventurer. I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? I've only just arrived, but you were waiting?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Please come this way. Iris You are here to visit me, but it is not polite to talk to you on the street like this.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Iris comes with Demigod Frozen and stays under Jiscard's protection.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Adventurer said he might come someday, so I asked him what to wear in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris knows what I look like... .

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: They say they saw Adventurer in their dreams. He spoke so vividly that I felt like I had known him for a long time.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Maybe that's why, but I also feel familiar with Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, where is Iris now?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Iris is training... , Shall we postpone this story until a little later?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: There is something I need you to do as soon as you get here. I'm really sorry. Currently, this place has been attacked by demons targeting Iris.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Adventurer may be having a hard time as it hasn't been long since you finished your work in Jude Kingdom... . I need you to help me here now.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: While we are dealing with the Deimos Church, Lux's unit has also invaded, so there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will help you. By the way, how many legions does Lux have? Even just like this, it’s huge… .

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: What appeared here was the 3rd Corps.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: It's not unreasonable to be surprised. The 3rd Corps appeared together with the 2nd Corps, and now we have confirmed that they have moved to a different location.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: We are continuing to track the movements of the 2nd and 3rd Corps, but we do not have accurate information yet.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: First of all, I explained all the information I know and have received so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Although Eastland is a place with many conflicts, it is rare to deal with demons. So everyone is cautious.  That's why I'm asking you a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will go out first and find out what the situation is.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Be careful. As you know from dealing with demons, the beings here are stronger than before... . Oh, you're already gone... .

steps.name: Deputy Commander Eden
steps.objective: Talk to [Eden], Deputy Commander of the Ruman Defense Force.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: You are amazing. I believed that your skills were not average, but I had no idea that you would be able to go to the canyon so quickly.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Iris It’s exactly what you said you saw in your dream.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris's dream... I think someone once told me about Iris's dream, but I can't remember...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I think it would be better to hear about what happens next from someone else rather than hearing it from me. Just now, Eden, who leads the main Luman defense force, has returned.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Eden has been guarding this place for a long time. He is as great as Geomshin Jiscard.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: He also wanted to meet Adventurer. What would you like to do? Hey, why are you doing that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: It's okay. Please tell me. If it's an embarrassing story, I'll keep it a secret... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Since Miya said that... . It wasn't a big deal and I thought I had reached Iris, but I was anxious because it seemed like it was taking a lot of time.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: If that's the case, don't worry. Because Iris is also looking forward to meeting Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Adventurer? Are you okay… . You look a little tired, so I'll cast a recovery spell on you. So relax.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Iris is feeling sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t have to be so sorry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll meet when the time comes, right?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Yes. I will definitely meet you. Have faith. You are the one who will become a goddess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miya, thanks to you, I feel better. Then, I will go straight to Eden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris, wait. I'll go.)

steps.name: Battlefield after sword
steps.objective: Defeat [Etin the Destroyer] and [Liora of the Snowy Mountain] in "White Call Canyon" and visit [El] to report.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I was waiting. Are you the Adventurer… that Iris was talking about? . I heard that you have solved many problems from Gendia to Freios.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Oh, I should say hello first. Something complicated has come up in the meantime, so it's a bit late to resolve it. I am Eden, the person in charge of the defense force of the Luman Alliance Headquarters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eden, my name is %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eden offers a warm handshake and shows a friendly smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your warm welcome.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: It's true that you should be wary of people you meet for the first time. Still, Jiscard told me to welcome him comfortably since he is the one who will do Iris's work.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I want to go with you and check your skills, but since I don't have time, I want you to start working right away. I know it's difficult, but I'm sure you'll be willing.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Now, let's go to the waterfall tree forest. Geomhu El is right there, so help him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Jiscard's fifth disciple, and although young, he has tremendous swordsmanship skills. At first, I also doubted his skills. Hahaha

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: He is truly an amazing person. Moreover, I never neglect training. So I have respect for it.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Is this enough of an answer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just from what you say, you seem like a great person. But are you there alone?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I guess I wanted to check it out for myself. That's why I got permission from Jiscard.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I'm not really that kind of person, so maybe I was frustrated for some reason... .

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: As I said just now, I went to the waterfall tree forest. The path to the waterfall tree forest is inside, so it shouldn't be difficult.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Go and help him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what's going to happen, so I'll come back quickly.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Then we will continue to strengthen Luman's barrier and search for other enemies.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: … Oh, you're already gone. Should I say that I have good decision-making skills, or that I have an impatient personality? .

steps.name: sweep
steps.objective: Defeat [Owlbear Regular Army] and [Ettin the Berserk] in “Waterfall Tree Forest”.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I felt a different energy from a normal person, so I thought it was an enemy, but no... .  Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (L looks surprised upon hearing %s's story.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Iris I heard that someone was coming to meet you. The fact that such a person came this far alone clearly means that he has skills... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it will help.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: No. I think it will definitely help. It looks like you have some understanding of the situation, so let's defeat the enemies here with me.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, follow me. This canyon is in the palm of my hand, so if you follow me, you will be able to meet the enemy without difficulty. Of course, it would be better if we never met.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This is the beginning, so be prepared.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It's awesome. Adventurer I thought he was just an ordinary person, but I didn't expect him to be this outstanding.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: As expected, Adventurer that Iris saw in his dream... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dream….)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What are you thinking like that? Come to your senses. Because this is a battlefield.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: There is still a lot of work left to do. Now that I’ve seen your skills, I want to trust you and entrust you with another task. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. are you okay.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Then, let me tell you briefly about the waterfall tree forest. The Waterfall Tree Forest is an important place that preserves the purity of the beginning, where druids, elves, and other ethnic groups live together.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It is such an important base. If enemy reinforcements flock here while the enemy is occupying this place, Luman will become increasingly dangerous.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The leader of the place is a female member of the Join tribe with purple wings. I think it will be enough to take down the leader. I have one concern. I think you'll be easier to deal with than me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Unfortunately, my sword cannot reach the enemy in the sky. Looking at your attack earlier, I saw that you dealt with the enemy regardless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, I'll try it. Instead, I hope El will clear the way. This is my first time walking through the forest, so I think I might get lost.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Of course. I'll open a path so you can get inside.

steps.name: Swordsman's youngest disciple
steps.objective: Talk to [El] in “White Call Canyon” and report to [Ul].

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I've taken care of it. I believed… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It's definitely different from the normal Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Thanks to this, the enemies in the forest are retreating. This is all thanks to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. We were able to do it because L was with us.  But what else is going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing else happened in the meantime, right?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Although the enemies retreated, there was a guy who chased after them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It seems that our youngest priest, Ul, saw that the enemies were heading towards the Jewel Tree Forest and ran away.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Huh, I urgently contacted the Alliance and asked them to send reinforcements... . It seems like it will take a long time.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I told him not to move alone like that, but he didn't listen. Huh, like me, you don't even bother to get permission from your teacher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did the priest named Ul go?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This is the place where the greedy ancient dragon Gluat stayed a long time ago. As the name suggests, it is a mysterious place with all kinds of jewels hanging on huge trees... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are places like that... . But why are you so anxious? Aren't you going to take care of the remnants?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That's because the 2nd Corps sent by Lux is currently staying there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Entering the enemy's base alone... , Even if it’s reckless, it’s too reckless.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Even though my teacher tells me not to be obsessed with fighting strong people, I still want to... .  Sister Yuran will also scold you later.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wait, the atmosphere is strange... . The movements of the enemies over there have changed. %s, do me a favor. I will guard this place, so you go to Ul.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm asking you to go first and take action so that Ul doesn't mess things up. Of course, he is a child with a strong ability to cry... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. You said it was a jewel tree forest, right? Then I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Got it. The road to the Jewel Tree Forest is… . You're already gone. I'll find it on its own... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, let me deal with you guys. You will have to pay the full price for coming to me... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Stop there. Who are you? Considering you've come this far, I guess you're not an ordinary bet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here to help you Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's the Adventurer that Iris was talking about. Well, that's enough. I don't need your help right now, so go back.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Otherwise, I'll cut you down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean now? Did I hear wrong?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It means that I am enough on my own without you. Can you see it just looking ahead? Many enemies who were targeting me were cut down by my sword... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Wool looks at %s's face with an annoyed expression.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I was going to cut it down if it didn't really go back, but it still wouldn't go. Iris That woman and you both have similarities,

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Even after hearing these insults, you never back down from what you have to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense. Iris is someone you shouldn't talk to like that.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't like it. Still, I won't fight you here. I'm going to win anyway, but there's no need to do that on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Now that things are like this, I want to see your skills. Go and deal with the enemies. And look for any traces of the Agashura guys.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I talking to you... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you had ever thought that I had information about Iris, you wouldn't have treated me like this. Don't give any other reasons, just help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a threat... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Think whatever you want.  Now, what do you want to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. Can I go inside? If you encounter an enemy, you can just deal with it as is, right?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yeah. I understand you well. I'll take care of the back, so don't worry about it and just move forward.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I will appreciate it with both eyes open... .

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: I can't believe it. I can't believe I was broken like this by a mere human. I won't make any excuses. Kill me, human. It's for everyone that it ends like this. therefore… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to hear the story... .

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: I have nothing to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux has many enemies in the demon world, so why did she come out without solving the problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you just targeting a girl who will become a god in order to become the master of this world? I'm asking because I'm a corps commander. Do you know anything? therefore… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t know? Or do you not want to answer? I can't help it. Then I have no choice but to end it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I, I... . eww. Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My head hurts….)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Step aside, %s. Leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: You fought with me back then... . Did you say wool... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I, why was I like that then….)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (For now, step back and rest. Be quiet about Agashura.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Hey, white cat. I know everything about your situation. So listen to me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's okay that you, who were prisoners, entered the demon world on your own. You had no choice but to go under Lux to save the White Lion clan you belonged to. Was that a good choice?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Those of you who have suffered here and there may be the only path you can choose.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you die here, your entire clan will end, right? Answer me… .

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: … That's right.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Okay. I heard that there are several similar cases within the corps. So, I'm making an offer, so take it.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: … what?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'll give you a separate task, so I want you to do it... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Aren’t you curious about the last time you fought with me and I backed away? I wanted to check out your skills.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The White Lion clan, including you. Surprisingly, you guys have a lot of places to write about, so I thought about it. I especially want to use you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You are respected by Lux and other subordinates in the demon world, so I think you would be perfect for the job of a spy.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So I decided. I will use you and take responsibility for your clan.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So you just have to choose.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: What are you talking about? Why me?!

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: We are giving you a chance to live on this land once again. Let me explain one more time. Even if you are sacrificed, your clan can dream of a future here again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what on earth are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: you are missing Because this is the story of this cat and me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Wouldn't it be better to see a little bit of the future here than to die meaninglessly in the demon world?

steps.name: Reclaim the Jewel Tree Forest
steps.objective: Report to [Eden], Deputy Commander of the Ruman Defense Force.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Thanks, it was helpful. I'll take care of the rest, so go back and tell Uncle Eden. They said everyone returned when Legion Commander Beskar retreated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you planning?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: To try something fun. I don't know yet whether I will do it or not. For now, I'm just making a plan. Don't reveal this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I try not to worry about that. by the way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you tell me not to talk about Agashura?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You may not know this, but two redheads were watching us around here. I think I was planning to take a look in secret and then return... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: As soon as the demons moved, they immediately ran away. These are the guys, right? Joined hands with the Morse Kingdom... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, he brainwashed the minority people with magic stones and made them attack the Kingdom of Jude... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yeah, it was something like that. That's why I wore strange things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm not sure, but it seemed like an artificial being. Different from ordinary demons, different from monsters... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Interesting… .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: But in order for this fun to continue, they have to show up quickly, but it's no fun because they hide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m not sure what kind of person Jiscard is, but why did he take Ul as his disciple?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you just listen to his story, he is one of the greatest people in the world...)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What are you thinking like that? First of all, with this, we stopped those guys from infiltrating and the demon attack, but what's even weirder?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: He caused a serious injury, so he won't appear for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it. Then I'll go back and let you know. Except what you did.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Well thought out. I told your story to the wizard named Asmara, so go to Uncle Eden and then go. It will open the way to the Federation Headquarters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: There is no need to make that face. Anyway, I just do what Master tells me to do. And if you don't want to fight me and win now, go away quickly... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Whoa, you left without even listening to the end of the story. But that guy's power... .

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: (Eden’s expression looks lighter after receiving the report.)

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I thought it would take a long time, but I'm glad it ended sooner than expected. It's thanks to the efforts of the Sword God's disciples and you. thank you.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: How do you feel about seeing Swordsman's Disciples? After all, they're not ordinary people, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was definitely not normal.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: That is why it is said that the Union of Light in Luman has a brighter future than other forces in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Once again representing the defense force. I'm telling you that you've had a hard time. Jiscard has given permission for you to go inside where the coalition headquarters is located.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Of course not. However, going inside is not something I can do. The coalition headquarters is surrounded by a powerful magical barrier, so only certified people can enter.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: To do that, you have to go to Asuma. Can you see the wizard with the jewel over there?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: It seems that Wool had requested this in advance even before Jiscard’s permission was given. As soon as I see you, I ask you to open the barrier and let me inside. Hehe, then let’s go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, that's what Wool said... I'm surprised...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Oh, I looked back and forth, and it was %s? I'm Asma. Please feel free to call me Asma.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Iris This is the person you were talking about, right? Eden, Jiscard, and I also had a favor to ask, so I already waited. I will open the barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Asma… . No, Asuma… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I finally came to Luman. I hope this journey ends here...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You've been verified. You can now enter the barrier, %s!
